about: One owner per file. Every script in scripts/ belongs to exactly one capability, with one role. A new script must be registered here in the same PR; check_layout.py fails otherwise. Roles: canonical (the one implementation product paths use), support (helpers of the canonical modules), experimental (research; product paths must not import it), shim (compatibility entry point that delegates), tool (lab tooling, harvesters), fixture (builds test/experiment inputs), frozen (kept only to reproduce old experiments; do not build on it). Written by the lead (T083); agents propose changes in their PR description, the lead applies them.

capabilities.title: The PPTX guidance skill (skills/pptx) and its small toolbox: look, motion by shape name
capabilities.notes: T087. skills/pptx/SKILL.md is the entry point for PPTX work. pptx_tools writes timing through pptx_animator (pptx.timing) and must not grow design decisions: those live in the guides.
